correctness.rationale: Rank-0 and rank-2 idempotents uniquely contribute at A nilpotent or A-I nilpotent. For rank-one projection E=u phi, phi(u)=1 and trE=1; over any field A-E nilpotent iff trA=1 and det(A-E)=0. Determinant expansion gives det(A-E)=d-1+phi(Au), hence phi(Au)=1-d. On non-A-invariant image lines, u and Au are a basis and exactly one phi works; on invariant eigenline all q choices work iff its eigenvalue 1-d. Since for trace-one char poly X²-X+d, evaluation at 1-d equals d², the latter is possible iff d=0 and exactly one eigenline contributes. Finite-field centralizers then yield class table and nil-clean locus counts. Independently enumerated all 2x2 matrices and rank idempotents over F2,F3,F5, verifying each single-matrix fiber and histograms; q4 extension and q7 original-script checks are not claimed as independently run. Analytic proof works for every prime power.
